note: The F11 Map page (src/systems/flow/globe_map.gd, src/ui/globe_view.gd): a globe of the planet with the places that stay put, each clickable to set a waypoint the HUD's objective pointer follows. Pins come from the world's landmarks (content/core/worlds/), the planet's native camps and the town's markers; nothing that moves is on it. 'kinds' names each landmark kind ('location' landmarks use their location file's kind); a location's own 'label' wins over the kind's, and 'labels' wins over both. 'skip' lists landmark ids left off. 'town' are the port's own stops, shown once zoomed in past 'town_zoom' (the port's pin hides then); the town's vendors (content/core/vendors/) are added to them. 'arrive' is how close (m) counts as there: the waypoint clears itself. 'off_planet' are the places in the sky: every planet you can fly to from here, and the Remnant cruiser when this world has one. Looks: content/look/map.json.

lines.none: Click a place to set a waypoint. Drag to turn, wheel to zoom.
lines.no_globe: No surface map here: this place is not a planet.
